en.bdb: How disciple becomes one with Guru    ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੰਨਣਹੁ ਕੋ ਚਲਿਤ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan hovai cha(n)nanahu ko chalit na jaanai|

en.bdb: None knows the mystery how in the association of sandal, other trees transform into sandal.
From lamp is illumined the lamp and looks identical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਰਲਦਾ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: paanee raladhaa paaneeaai tis ko na sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: No one can identify that water which mixes into water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੀੜਿਅਹੁ ਕਿਵ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhira(n)gee hovai keeRiahu kiv aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: The small aunt turns into bhringiinsect; none can tell about it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਪੁ ਛੁਡੰਦਾ ਕੁੰਜ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sap chhudda(n)dhaa ku(n)j no kar choj viddaanai|

en.bdb: The snake leaves its slough and this is again a wonderful feat.
Similarly, the love between the Guru and disciple is wondrous.
